metadata.description: Give your child the tools to become a confident reader with this engaging audio! Through five stages—rhyming, word parts, sound positions, segmenting, and manipulating sounds—kids will explore the 44 sounds in the English language. With fun, flexible activities, they’ll build key reading skills while enjoying playful learning at their own pace!
